commentary_title: Higher fleet utilisation and tonne-mile demand support Handysize rates despite easing congestion
commentary_summary: Handysize utilisation increased further, reflecting stronger fleet employment. The improvement coincided with firmer regional and minor-bulk activity, while other Handysize cargoes such as grain, fertilisers, steel products and forest products continued to support vessel deployment. | The tonne-mile index rose WoW, strengthening the underlying demand picture. Longer-haul grain sourcing and changing trade routes could provide additional support to Handysize shipping demand over the remaining weeks of 2026. | Laden congestion declined sharply across regions, including China, releasing capacity and improving vessel supply. This may partly offset the impact of firmer demand on freight rates in the region.
